hero.title: A Story Rooted in Balinese Tradition
hero.body: Experience the passion, heritage, and heartfelt hospitality that have made Raja Bali a destination for authentic Balinese cuisine.

ourStory.heading: Our Story
ourStory.body: Founded with a passion for preserving authentic Balinese cuisine, Raja Bali brings generations of traditional recipes to the table, carefully prepared with fresh local ingredients, aromatic herbs, and authentic cooking techniques. We want every guest to leave having discovered something of Bali's true flavors and spirit, not just had a meal.

featureRows.title: Inspired by Tradition, Crafted with Passion
featureRows.desc: At Raja Bali, we believe authentic cuisine begins with respect: for tradition, for ingredients, and for every guest who dines with us. We're committed to preserving Bali's rich culinary heritage while presenting every dish with care, quality, and a modern touch.

featureRows.title: Fresh Ingredients, Authentic Flavors
featureRows.desc: Every memorable Balinese dish begins with exceptional ingredients. We carefully source fresh local produce, aromatic herbs, traditional spices, and premium ingredients from trusted local suppliers.

featureRows.title: The Heart of Balinese Hospitality
featureRows.desc: Hospitality is at the heart of everything we do. From the moment you arrive until your final farewell, our team is dedicated to making every guest feel genuinely welcomed.

quoteBlock.line2: It is our greatest pleasure to share the authentic flavors, traditions, and warm hospitality of Bali with guests from around the world.
quoteBlock.line3: We are truly grateful for your trust and support. Thank you for choosing Raja Bali Restaurant.

closingCTA.heading: Experience the True Taste of Bali
closingCTA.body: Come taste real Balinese cooking and experience the hospitality that keeps our guests coming back.
